rationale: cmd_prove and its ll-loop run ready-to-implement-gate invocation already exist and are directly callable; two direct precedents for naming an exact fix-it command per row (normalize.py:491, rn-implement.yaml:1658); Option B's version-stamp mechanic is precedented only for little-loops' own version and would break 7 production call sites of is_record_stale plus a 6-test class.
rule: Option A — make re-proving reachable (name exact remediation command per row; optional --reprove flag)
alternatives_rejected: Option B (gate on installed version) — durable but high blast radius, deferred as future work per issue's own recommendation; Option C (raise stale_after_days alone) — silences symptom without fixing dead-end
